control_prompt: Read this workspace's repository state, then produce the detailed action plan you would follow to establish this project's engineering governance — the standards the project will be held to — so that it reflects the maintainers' declared intent and lands where Claude Code loads it automatically.
expected_output: Greenfield branch: the workspace holds a product README and a user-written CLAUDE.md with no governance markers, no .mochiko/ and no source, so the mode proposed from what the workspace shows is greenfield (the user rules it where ambiguous). Plan must show: the interrogation run inline by the lead (agenda dimensions adaptively, then the catalog deck card by card, recommend-then-arbitrate) with every card and module ruling the user's; the synthesis written to .mochiko/memory/governance-intent.md and stress-tested by a cold seat dispatched blind in two messages before the user's ratification gate; only then the surface set authored (CLAUDE.md governance region inside fresh markers with the existing user notes untouched, scoped rules files, the ledger, the trace summary); an independent grade of the authored files; the user's acceptance flagged proposal by flagged proposal; and at close an empty FEATURES.md index scaffolded plus the architecture store created with a spine.md stub carrying its Scope: line, with no architecture stance taken and the product baselines left to the first implement run.
assertions: mode proposed as greenfield from the workspace, with the user's ruling described
synthesis ratification gate described before any surface is authored
empty FEATURES.md scaffolded; product baselines explicitly deferred
architecture store scaffolded with a Scope: line and no ruled architecture content
the user's CLAUDE.md notes outside the governance markers are never touched

control_prompt: Read this workspace's repository state, then produce the detailed action plan you would follow to establish engineering governance for this existing codebase — the standards it will be held to — so that it reflects the maintainers' declared intent, accounts for how the code actually behaves today, and lands where Claude Code loads it automatically.
expected_output: Brownfield branch: a running Express + SQLite service with no .mochiko/, no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md, so the mode proposed is brownfield. Plan must show the codebase analysis into .mochiko/memory/codebase-analysis.md feeding the interrogation, and must confront the three planted reality-versus-declared conflicts as the user's rulings, never resolved silently: (1) README says every route is covered by a test, but DELETE /links/:id has none; (2) README says secrets never appear in logs, but the request log line prints the x-api-key header value; (3) README says the service runs no background jobs, but src/db.js starts a nightly setInterval purge inside the web process. From the same analysis the plan must reconstruct the feature map — capabilities derived from the routes and modules (link capture, listing/filtering, deletion, API-key access control) — confirmed with the user entry by entry and landed as FEATURES.md plus .mochiko/features/ entries marked delivered and reconstructed from code, and must bootstrap the product baselines (data model, contracts, constraints and decisions, quickstart) under .mochiko/product/ from the delivered code. Same spine as s1 for the synthesis, cold stress-test, ratification, authoring, independent grade, acceptance; store scaffolded with its Scope: line declared backend-service.
assertions: mode proposed as brownfield; codebase analysis feeds the interrogation
all three planted conflicts surfaced as the user's rulings, none silently resolved
feature map reconstructed from the code and confirmed entry by entry
product baselines bootstrapped from the delivered code
no surface authored before the synthesis is ratified

args: add a principle covering how long we keep customer data, and tighten the pre-release checks
control_prompt: Read this workspace's repository state, then produce the detailed action plan you would follow to update this project's existing engineering governance so that it adds a principle covering how long customer data is kept and tightens the pre-release checks, keeping everything already agreed intact.
expected_output: Amend branch: the workspace already carries a governance surface set (CLAUDE.md region between the mochiko:governance markers, two scoped rules files, the ledger at v1.2.0, the synthesis with GI-001..GI-007), so the mode proposed is amend and the request in $ARGUMENTS scopes it. Plan must show the delta worked against the existing synthesis — the synthesis extended with new GI elements and its amendment log appended, never replaced, and neither durable ever offered for deletion — re-ratified by the user before any surface is regenerated, then the region regenerated between its markers with the user's Peartree notes and contributor section outside them untouched, and both carve-outs preserved verbatim: the mochiko:output-style switch line keeping the user's conversation: lite value, and the output-style rules file keeping its user-added Wren Studio line. The stale .mochiko/memory/constitution.md is superseded — deleted on sight with a one-line note. The store scaffold creates only what is missing: concerns.md is absent so it is created, while spine.md and its existing Scope: line are left alone. No feature-map write at all on an amend — FEATURES.md and FEAT-001 exist and are not touched. Semver bump on the region and the ledger, trace summary, independent grade, acceptance flagged proposal by flagged proposal.
assertions: mode proposed as amend from the existing surface set, not brownfield
synthesis extended delta-wise and re-ratified before any regeneration
both carve-outs preserved verbatim, including the user's conversation: lite value
stale constitution.md deleted on sight with a one-line note
concerns.md created because missing; spine.md and its Scope: line left alone
no feature-map write on the amend path
